overview.title: The saga
overview.text:
Grandmother Naadag, an elder of the Diné Republic who had lived most of her life in Cahokia, chose the day of her own death and held a Seeing for it. The characters came to it by different roads. At its end she asked them, in a private meeting that was not recorded, to carry a box back to the Diné Republic. They leave Cahokia on the morning of the eleventh day with Sign asleep and shaking, and with no way to wake her. [SET]

The trip is about a week and a half with stops. It is not a busy route, nothing about the delivery is urgent, and they are not trying to rush it. [SET — the prep note] They navigate by a song map. [SET — session 3 recap]

*Naadag Hasaka* is Chahi for *Crow Mesa*: *Naadag*, crow; *Hasaka*, mesa. [SOURCE — the book's glossary]

overview.title: The Seeing
overview.text:
The Story Guide's invention for this saga [YOURS]. A Seeing is for a respected elder choosing their own death, and runs ten days:

- Days 1–2: arrivals, informal greetings, food, games. Nobody has to be there at the start.
- Days 3–4: the long tables — speeches, stories, the gift-giving and the feast (day 3); the life told by several storytellers, then speeches by leaders and elders (day 4).
- Days 5–6: the elder withdraws with one or two attendants to prepare; the guests are quieter, reflect, rest. The kitchens close.
- Day 7: the death at dawn, privately. The attendants take a blocker against the compound burned in the room; it stops the elder's body.
- Days 8–9: the body is viewed, then buried or cremated; mourning.
- Day 10: farewells and dispersal. Anyone not gone by the end of it is expected to be.

About two hundred people came to Grandmother's, counting children. Not everyone is given a Seeing; her husband's death, about fifteen years earlier, was quiet.

sections.title: The Black
sections.text: Everyone experiences the Black in their own way, and the same person may see it differently at different times. [SET] Sign: a translucent overlay on the world that darkens the deeper she goes, until she loses where she is and stops hearing speech. Suva: a spirit body that moves while her senses are set aside, hazy until she focuses on a place. Makatooka: vivid, dreamlike, first person, and she reads it as her own subconscious rather than anything outside her.

sections.title: The wild corridor
sections.text: A broad north–south stretch of the continent, west of Cahokia, is kept wild by general agreement as a migration path; people go into it only when there is a need. Datsu's people herd near it. Not in the book. [YOURS]

sections.title: Getting around, keeping in touch
sections.text: Few wheeled vehicles; most things float or hover, and there are paths more than roads. Networks are regional and each state runs its own; out in the Free Lands, communities have their own or chain from place to place, and there are long stretches with no signal. Most people wear a small device on the arm that texts and reaches the local network. A Diné device needs reworking to talk to Cahokia's. You always stop for someone on foot. [SET]

sections.title: Drink, and kalera root
sections.text: There is no alcohol culture. The everyday drinks are brewed from herbs and fungus, microdoses that even children take, like weak beer once was; stronger brews and distillations go up to "don't operate heavy machinery". [SET] Kalera root is the base of many of them: it raises blood flow, dulls pain, and is mildly hallucinogenic. Kalera root that the Adanadi has marked is the nearest thing to a controlled substance: it cannot be grown reliably (growers make the conditions and hope; there is research into it), and for someone who already carries the Adanadi it has a resonance that heightens what they feel. Makatooka will not have regular access to it. [SET] Substances are not banned as such; someone who is a danger to themselves or others through use can be made to accept support. [SET] Spelling of *kalera* not confirmed. [OPEN]

sections.title: Food
sections.text: Vegetarianism exists; veganism does not really, since what it avoids mostly never came over or was never made. [SET]

sections.title: The year
sections.text: Zibizin went missing in 703, "seven years ago", so the Seeing is in 710. [SET — session 1] Wasawi was fourteen in session 1 and sixteen from session 2 on; the table settled on sixteen. [SET]

overview.title: The prep note (recorded)
overview.text:
The Story Guide's spoken prep note for the next session, auto-transcribed and kept word for word in `campaign/source/prep-note.txt`. What it plans is in Scenes (*Next*) and Threads. [SOURCE]

> Grandmother and a dog is dead. The rest of them pack up, they get ready to head out. Sign has been. Stable. But, You won't wake up. She's going on something of a journey. Suva knows enough, not to wake her. Suvo is pretty upset with wazowi. But this is their secret. How is suva found out? What is it that they want? Sine has been connected within a crime families. Suva is connected within a crime families. And grandmother and a dog. Is from the delay republic. Grandmother nadog has been protecting suva. Unpronounced to her. That protection has faltered. Here's what's going to happen. They're going to get about two days up. It's probably gonna take. Week week and a half with stops. To get into the delay republic. It's not exactly a Heavily traversed transit thing. There's nothing that's urgently needed from that. Correction. Um, and they're not also They're not trying to rush it. Forget about two days and they'll find a stove. The stove is. A five-year-old. Just gives them a chance. Do they go back or not? Do they try to pass the kit off somehow? Make a tuka. Has a bad trip. Pouring water on her miscarried baby. What does that mean? Or miscarried baby is going to be an oracle to her. She's going to have to use deception. To avoid the others figuring out what that's all about. Take us on board with us. Young. Hungry. Kind of nine years. Looking for a get rich quick scheme and they're really isn't on out here. Will definitely be sympathetic. Crime, family stuff. Maybe chica has been given a side job. Make sure that suva speaks with her cousin. Coyote city. How soon until later, tooka hits withdrawal. We're just song map. Take them.

overview.title: Names still to confirm
overview.text:
The recordings were auto-transcribed and spell names several ways; these are the spellings used here. [OPEN]

- Suva (Silva, Soda, Siva, Suvo, Sylva)
- Sign (Sine)
- Datsu (Dotsu, Tatsu, Natsu)
- Makatooka (Megatooka, Makeatooka, Nigatuka, Takeatoka; "Tuka")
- Wasawi (Wazowi, Wasawhi, Lazawi; once spelled W-A-D-A-W-I)
- Zibizin ("Zip is in", "Zipism"; spelled B-I-Z-I-N at the table)
- Ninosh (Enosh)
- Kalera root (Calera, cholera, Clara)
- Tika, Yohipa and Choyan were spelled out at the table.

rules.title: Stats for a Skill
rules.text: A Skill with Ranks uses the higher of its two Stats; a Skill at 0 uses the lower. [SET — as played, sessions 1 and 3]

rules.title: Finding your way in a new city
rules.text: Orienting in an unfamiliar city is Survival with Intelligence instead of Endurance. [SET — session 1]

rules.title: Net below zero
rules.text: A Check with net fewer than zero Successes is a critical failure: the character does not get what they wanted and makes things worse for themselves. [SET — session 2]

rules.title: Stars and wishes
rules.text: At the end of a session anyone may name a star (a moment they loved) and a wish (something they'd like to see). [SET]

people.title: Grandmother Naadag
people.text:
Nearly 121 at her death. From the Diné Republic; arrived in Cahokia in late adolescence; husband died about fifteen years before the Seeing; lost children of her own. Ceremonial more than spiritual. Honoured by the Council of Twelve for neighbourhood work copied across the city. [SET]

The early part of her life, as the family tells it, has deliberate gaps. Sign came away convinced they concern Grandmother and the Black: something she met there and has been getting away from, dangerous enough that it is better not to know there is anything to avoid. That reading came from a critical failure and may be wrong. [OPEN]

She was protecting Suva without Suva's knowledge, and that protection has faltered. [SET — the prep note] Who reached Sign through the Black with the family's name is not established. [OPEN]

people.title: Ninosh
people.text: An accomplished cook, vegetarian, interested in where her food comes from. Flirted with Datsu all of day 2; he did not notice until Makatooka said it aloud. "Seek me out if you're ever so inclined." [SET]

people.title: Choyan
people.text: Early fifties, knows current cybernetics research well. Disproved several of Tika's hypotheses in one conversation. Tika has made a note of the name. [SET]

people.title: Yohipa
people.text: Tika's older sister, about 25. Runs a successful restaurant in Cahokia that Grandmother helped her start; her kitchen was one of several feeding the Seeing. Owes Tika money she can't pay before he leaves. The Story Guide suggested an indirect link: Makatooka may know the restaurant without knowing Tika. [OPEN]

people.title: Zibizin
people.text: Wasawi's father, partner of Suva's daughter. Taught Makatooka to fly. Went missing in 703, seven years before the Seeing, exploring. [SET] Whether Suva's daughter went with Zibizin or died later is told both ways in session 1 ("both my daughter and her partner are missing"; "my daughter died two years ago"); Grandmother and the chronicle treat the daughter as dead. [OPEN]

people.title: Suva's husband
people.text: Grandmother Naadag's grandson; a farmer. Wasawi calls him Papa. Staying in Cahokia with their grandson, who is eight. [SET]

people.title: The attending healer
people.text: Attended Grandmother's last two days with Suva, and took the first long watch. Not named. Suva kept Wasawi's presence from them. [SET]

people.title: The uncles
people.text: A trio at the dice table, a day and a half of play by day 2. Took Sign as their luck; did not make room for Tika. [SET]

people.title: Makatooka's colleague
people.text: A colleague from Makatooka's hospital she never got on with, still working there; met on day 2. Not named. [SET]

sections.title: At the table
sections.text: 62, Healer, Path of the Snake ("pack of the steak" in the transcript), Motivation Family. Married into the family forty years ago; her own family died in a fire in her early twenties. Raising Wasawi and her eight-year-old brother with her husband. First Seeing she has led. Wears Grandmother's heirloom jewellery. Path not confirmed. [OPEN]

sections.title: Numbers heard in play
sections.text: Ceremony Rank 3, rolled with 8 dice (Spirit the higher Stat, so Spirit 5); Wisdom 3; Perception 3; Charisma 3; Intelligence 2; Music 0. Has Walk The Black (costs a point of Mind and a point of Soul, as played). [SOURCE — the recordings]

sections.title: What she carries
sections.text:
Wasawi hid in the closet on the last night; Suva gave her the blocker and kept it from the attending healer and the family. It is their secret; Suva is angry with her. [SET]

From the prep note: Grandmother had been protecting Suva without her knowledge, and that protection has faltered. "How is Suva found out? What is it that they want?" The note also connects someone to "crime families" — it names both Sign and Suva, and which is meant is not clear. Suva may be asked to speak with a cousin in Coyote City. [YOURS — the prep note] [OPEN]

sections.title: At the table
sections.text: 42, from the Diné Republic, Seeker, Path of the Beaver, Motivation Justice. Past involvement with criminal organisations. Was investigating a wrong done to a poor man in Coyote City; dropped it after the vision. Has Quiet Mind. Grandmother's gift: a necklace connected to the spirit world. [SET]

sections.title: Numbers heard in play
sections.text: Survival Rank 2; Investigation with Intelligence came to 10 dice; Wisdom 3; Charm rolled 2 dice. [SOURCE — the recordings, loosely heard] [OPEN]

sections.title: Asleep
sections.text: On day 10 she would not wake, and shook at intervals; otherwise healthy. Prep note: "She's going on something of a journey. Suva knows enough not to wake her." [YOURS — the prep note]

sections.title: At the table
sections.text: 32, Scout, Path of the Raccoon, Motivation Independence. Herds buffalo with his people near the wild corridor; good with animals; a survivalist. His people's long business friendship with the family is why they supplied the Seeing. Oblivious to Ninosh. Handles food and shelter for the journey; takes what is provided and scrounges the rest. [SET]

sections.title: At the table
sections.text: 28, Healer, Motivation Altruism. A physician on leave of absence because of her addiction; strongest in Knowledge, with science and medicine, some herbalism; can pilot (Zibizin taught her). Gift: Spirit World Connection. Burden: Addiction ("uppers and downers", "the good stuff"; now kalera). Companion: a hairless cat, Wings. Packed a trauma kit, her herbal knowledge in her wrist device, a raven keepsake. Left Grandmother's blanket in safe keeping. Performance 0, Spirit 4. [SET]

sections.title: Private: the lost child
sections.text:
Only the Story Guide and her player know this; the public pages do not tell it. [NOTE]

She miscarried about seven years ago, close to when Zibizin vanished, and her addiction took hold then. Grandmother's blanket — a falcon reworked into a fox — is understood by Makatooka in connection with that. On day 5, on a doubled kalera tea, she saw the tea overflow a bowl and, under it, the child she imagines she would have had, rising for air; she threw the tea and the bowl was empty. She tried to hide it and did not manage. [SET]

Prep note: the miscarried child "is going to be an oracle to her", and she "will have to use deception to avoid the others figuring out what that's all about". "How soon until Makatooka hits withdrawal." In session 3 the Story Guide checked with the table about discussing the miscarriage in play; confirm before bringing it forward. [YOURS — the prep note] [OPEN]

sections.title: At the table
sections.text: 19, Tinkerer, Path of the Raccoon; can inspire others. From the Haudenosaunee Confederacy (a family that kept its own ways, so second-tier there). Cybernetic eye (an orb, not made to look natural; he pushes it and could break it), a small drone, some judo, a cook. Gambling habit; about thirty thousand won and lost; broke. Dream: electronics that reproduce the Adanadi. Won the apprentice-mechanic slot on the barge west in his own bluffing dice game. Wealth 3. Motivation not heard clearly. [SET] [OPEN]

sections.title: From the prep note
sections.text: "Young. Hungry. … Looking for a get rich quick scheme and there really isn't one out here. Will definitely be sympathetic. Crime family stuff. Maybe [Tika] has been given a side job: make sure Suva speaks with her cousin. Coyote City." The note's "Chica" is read here as Tika. [YOURS] [OPEN]

sections.title: At the table
sections.text: Suva's granddaughter and companion, 16, Scout, Path of the Fox, Motivation Curiosity. Wild; spent night 2 in the forest park. Snuck into Grandmother's rooms before the death and hid in the closet; Suva caught her through the Black and gave her the blocker. Apologised at the viewing. Likely to take to Tika and his cybernetics. [SET]

places.title: Cahokia
places.text: The Seeing was held on the family's grounds by the lake, with family housing in the residential areas around it. The city has a large interior forest park: trails well trodden, a highway a mile and a half off. Paths along the lake and the river. [SET] The book's Cahokia is in the Rules & Book pane. [SOURCE]

places.title: The Diné Republic
places.text: Grandmother's homeland and Sign's; where the box goes. A week and a half away with stops. [SET]

places.title: Oraibi
places.text: The oldest town in the Diné Republic. Sign saw it in the Black on day 1, as it may have looked before the Awis: a pueblo, people in old clothes. [SET]

places.title: Coyote City
places.text: Where Sign was investigating when the vision came. The prep note has Suva speaking with a cousin there. [YOURS] [OPEN]

threads.title: The box for the Diné Republic
threads.text: Grandmother's last request, given in a private meeting that was not recorded. What is in it, and whom it is for, is not written down anywhere. [OPEN]

threads.title: Sign will not wake
threads.text: "She's going on something of a journey." Stable, shaking at intervals; Suva knows not to wake her. [YOURS — the prep note]

threads.title: What Grandmother left out
threads.text: The deliberate gaps in her early life; Sign's conviction that they concern the Black and something dangerous there. Who reached Sign through the Black with the family's name. [OPEN]

threads.title: Grandmother's protection, faltering
threads.text: Grandmother had been protecting Suva without her knowing; with Grandmother dead it has faltered. How is Suva found out, and what do they want? Crime families. [YOURS — the prep note] [OPEN]

threads.title: Wasawi in the closet
threads.text: Suva and Wasawi's secret; Suva is upset with her. [SET]

threads.title: Makatooka's addiction
threads.text: No regular access to kalera on the road; withdrawal is coming. The day-5 vision; the oracle (see the note on Makatooka). [YOURS] [OPEN]

threads.title: Zibizin and Suva's daughter
threads.text: Missing seven years, gone exploring; the family keeps it quiet. What became of them. [OPEN]

threads.title: The stowaway
threads.text: Planned: about two days out they find a stowaway, a five-year-old. Do they go back? Try to pass the child on? [YOURS — the prep note]

threads.title: Tika's debts and dreams
threads.text: Yohipa owes him; he owes nobody yet. Gambling. Choyan as a contact. The cybernetic Adanadi. [SET]

threads.title: Ninosh
threads.text: "Seek me out if you're ever so inclined." [SET]

threads.title: Makatooka's hospital
threads.text: On leave of absence; the colleague expects she may never be back. [SET]

threads.title: Sign's case in Coyote City
threads.text: The wrong done to a poor man that Sign dropped when the vision came, and the deeper thing she found under it. [OPEN]

arc.title: Arrival
arc.text: Suva asked to attend Grandmother; Datsu called in from the herds; Sign's vision and the ride; Sign alone in Cahokia; Oraibi in the Black; Suva and Makatooka; Sign meets Grandmother ("I have a gift for you, but it will need to wait"). Chapter 1.

arc.title: The second day
arc.text: Ninosh and Datsu; Makatooka and her colleague; Wasawi's night in the forest; Sign and the uncles' dice; Suva's preparations.

arc.title: The third day
arc.text: The long tables, the Council of Twelve, Suva's story; the gifts — Sign's necklace, Makatooka's blanket, Suva's jewellery; the feast.

arc.title: The fourth day
arc.text: The life told with its gaps; Sign's reading of them; the speeches. Then the private meeting and the box (not recorded). Chapter 2.

arc.title: The fifth to the seventh days
arc.text: Tika's first days (Choyan, the dice game, the job). Makatooka's doubled tea. Suva's two days with Grandmother; Wasawi in the closet; Tika sparring at dawn; the death.

arc.title: The eighth to the tenth days
arc.text: The viewing and the burial; packing, the barge west, Tika meets Datsu; the credit for the trip; Sign will not wake. Chapter 3. Next session was set for Friday the 19th.

arc.title: Leaving Cahokia
arc.text: Day 11, morning. The barge west with Sign aboard and asleep. [YOURS — the prep note]

beats.title: Suva and Wasawi
beats.text: Suva is still upset with her; their secret.

arc.title: Two days out
arc.text: They find a stowaway, a five-year-old. Go back or not? Pass the child off somehow? [YOURS — the prep note]

beats.title: Makatooka
beats.text: Withdrawal, and how soon. The oracle: she must use deception so the others don't work out what it is.

beats.title: Tika's side job
beats.text: Make sure Suva speaks with her cousin in Coyote City. [OPEN]
